Torches, rope, provisions and gear for beginners. Also buys loot.
Potions, runes and wands. I buy crystals and pearls too.
May the light guide you. I can heal you.
The area needs help. I have tasks for you.
The cart to other towns leaves whenever you wish. You pay in coins.
Potions for the tough and I buy everything you bring from beyond the bridge.
The account is shared with all town banks.
Beyond the camp real danger begins. I have tasks for the strongest.
My ship sails to Qasirah, the southern islands and East Harbor. You pay in coins.
The reefs around the island are treacherous, but I know the way to the ports. You pay in coins.
Nobody on this island asks where you are from. You will sail away if you pay.
It is easy to get lost in the fog. I will take you back to the port.
Ice crushes hulls, but my ship will survive the voyage to East Harbor.
Ash in the sails, but we sail on. I am heading back to East Harbor.
The Valmir temple welcomes sailors and wanderers.
Valmir Bank keeps accounts in all towns.
Fish, provisions and rope for anyone going down into the sewers.
Houses by the harbor. You pay from your bank account.
Weapons and armor forged in the port.
Runes and potions straight from the academy.
I buy loot from the sewers and surroundings.
The cart to other towns is waiting. You pay in coins.
Under Valmir there are sewers full of rats. Good for a first hunt.
The temple of the Emerald Isles welcomes travelers.
Nerys Bank keeps accounts in all towns.
Fruit, provisions and torches for the islands.
Villas among the palms. You pay from your bank account.
Weapons and armor from all over the world.
Runes and potions for island explorers.
I buy loot from the islands and the jungle.
By ferry and cart to other towns. You pay in coins.
The Emerald Isles hide many secrets. Will you help?
The Qasirah temple welcomes the wanderer.
Qasirah Bank keeps accounts in all towns.
Dates, water and rope for the road across the desert.
Goods from Qasirah and buying of loot from the area.

The caravan to other towns is waiting. You pay in coins.
Sabers and armor of the finest bazaar steel.
Runes, potions and wands from distant lands.
Qasirah houses on the palm-lined lane. You pay from your bank account.

Frostholm Bank keeps accounts in all towns.
Mulled beer, provisions and rope for the frost.
Goods from Frostholm and buying of loot from the area.
The area around Frostholm is dangerous. Will you help?
The sleds to other towns are waiting. You pay in coins.
Steel from mountain ore. You can buy weapons and armor here.
Runes and potions from the library on the terrace.
Houses in the lower town and on the terraces. You pay from your bank account.

Goods from Selvaran and buying of loot from the area.

Houses in the royal quarter. You pay from your bank account.

May the Great Tree protect you. I will tell you about the forest and the hunt for the outcasts.
Gold and the depot are safe here like the roots of trees.
Bows of yew and ash, they shoot without ammunition. I also buy wood and hides.
Potions, herbs and wands for forest wanderers.
Welcome to the top of the Great Tree. You can see the whole forest from here... and the outcasts roaming it.
Welcome to the temple of Durnkar, son and daughter of stone. I can heal you or take you into the town.
The gold in the Durnkar treasury lies under a thousand fathoms of rock. The bank keeps accounts in all towns.
Houses in the Durnkar cave, warm from the lava. You pay from your bank account.
Durnkar remembers the days when there were no towns above the mountains. I will give you a premium account and a promotion just like the king in Varden: type premium or promocja.
Cave-mushroom beer, bread, meat and rope for the road. Sit down, stranger.
Axes, hammers and crossbows from the Durnkar forge. I also buy weapons and ore.
Armor forged in the heat of lava: helmets, mail and shields for every warrior.
Runes carved in stone hold the power of saturations. Life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections.
Potions, runes and wands. Dwarven runes do not crack even in battle.
Rope, shovels, torches and miner helmets - everything you need in the mine.
I will buy loot from the mines and sell what you are missing on the road.
Ravens from the mountain crags follow the dwarf deep into the mine. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
The mines around Durnkar teem with renegades and monsters from the depths. Each floor down is more dangerous.
By minecart along the old tracks under the mountains to other towns. You pay in coins, keep your beard inside.
Halt! Few reach Durnkar through the gorge. Come in, since you are here, and do not lose your way back.
Behind this gate lies the Iron Beard Mine. The doors let through only those who survive the depths.
Puppies from Varden: loyal and cheerful. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
I saturate weapons and armor: life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections. The blacksmith does the same.
Mountain ravens do not fear the frost. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
Welcome to Frostholm. I will give you a premium account and a promotion just like the king in Varden: type premium or promocja.
Ice holds the power of saturations. Life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections - choose an item.
Ginger kittens from the port catch rats and luck. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
Selvaran welcomes guests. I will give you a premium account and a promotion just like the king in Varden: type premium or promocja.
Jungle sap strengthens saturations. Life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections.
The fennecs of the desert hear an enemy from afar. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
The desert belongs to Qasirah. I will give you a premium account and a promotion just like the king in Varden: type premium or promocja.
Sand and sun make saturations last. Life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections.
Gulls from the port find every fish. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
Valmir Port welcomes sailors. I will give you a premium account and a promotion just like the king in Varden: type premium or promocja.
Sea salt does not harm my saturations. Life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections.
The parrots of the islands repeat every word. A pet at your side gives +5% experience from monsters.
Welcome to the Emerald Isles. I will give you a premium account and a promotion just like the king in Varden: type premium or promocja.
Island pearls carry the power of saturations. Life leech, mana leech, crit, elements and protections.
Peace be with you, wanderer. I am Brother Anselm of the chapel outside Varden. I can give you Spiritual Shielding. Say: blessing.
The frost has no power in this chapel, wanderer. I am Sister Brigid and I give the Embrace of Tibia. Say: blessing.
May the sand spare you, wanderer. I am Brother Hamid and I give the Fire of the Suns. Say: blessing.
The sea and the fire protect those who believe. I am Sister Martha and I give the Spark of the Phoenix (premium account). Say: blessing.
The silence of the jungle teaches wisdom. I am Brother Cyprian and I give the Wisdom of Solitude (premium account). Say: blessing.
Fate is kind to the careful. I am Sister Fortunata and I give the Twist of Fate (premium account). Say: blessing.
The star above us is dying. I keep the Seal, and I have missions for those of level 300 and up.
Welcome to the temple. Ask me about blessings.
I sail to the mainland. Premium accounts only.
Step inside (Abandoned Mill (interior)) and have a look around.
Spiders have taken over the mill. Defeat 8 so the grain can be ground again.
Wolves lie in the granary upstairs. Defeat 6 and the chests at the top of the mill are yours.
Cobwebs have swallowed my mill. Will you help me win back the granary?
Inside: Crypt of the Silent Bell
Step inside (Crypt of the Silent Bell (depths)) and have a look around.
Centipedes hold the lower chambers. Defeat 6 and the bellringer's hoard opens.
Crypt of the Silent Bell, near Varden
The bell in the crypt has gone silent and footsteps echo at night. Someone must go down.
Step inside (The Poacher's Den (depths)) and have a look around.
Snow wolves thrash in the snares. Defeat 10 before they turn on the caravans.
The poachers guard a hoard deep in the den. Defeat 6 and take the loot.
Someone is snaring my wolves. Find the cave the poachers come out of.
Inside: Well of the Buried Oasis
Step inside (Well of the Buried Oasis (depths)) and have a look around.
Scorpions have bred in the well. Defeat 12 and reach the caravan chests.
Well of the Buried Oasis, near Qasirah
Sand has buried the oasis and beasts nest in its well. Without water the caravans die.
Inside: Barrow of the Candle Court
Step inside (Barrow of the Candle Court (depths)) and have a look around.
Acolytes guard the court entrance. Defeat 10.
Lanterns drift through the throne chamber. Defeat 6 and the court's treasure is yours.
Barrow of the Candle Court, near Varden
Candles burn under the barrow that no one lit. The dead court wants to be remembered.
Step inside (Hrimvard Watchtower (interior)) and have a look around.
Frozen boars root beneath the tower. Defeat 8.
Yetis hold the upper floors. Defeat 6 and the garrison vault opens.
The Hrimvard tower has been silent since winter. The last sentinel froze at the top holding his lantern.
Inside: Ziggurat of the Scorched Sun
Step inside (Ziggurat of the Scorched Sun (depths)) and have a look around.
Striped prowlers guard the priests' vault. Defeat 6.
Ziggurat of the Scorched Sun, near Qasirah
The ziggurat under the dune gives off heat even at night. I seek someone to look into its chambers.
Step inside (Bogwater Chapel (depths)) and have a look around.
Bog wraiths drift through the chapel. Defeat 12.
Lizards have taken the main nave. Defeat 8 and the chapel vault opens.
The chapel sank into the bog, yet its bells still ring under water. I need someone with a strong arm.
Inside: Shrine of the Gilded Coil
Step inside (Shrine of the Gilded Coil (depths)) and have a look around.
Serpents fill the shrine halls. Defeat 12.
Former treasure hunters guard the altar. Defeat 8 and the coil's treasure is yours.
Shrine of the Gilded Coil, near Selvaran
The Shrine of the Gilded Coil no longer answers prayers. Snakes crawled out of the statues.
Inside: Lighthouse of the Green Mists
Step inside (Lighthouse of the Green Mists (interior)) and have a look around.
Lizard hexers hold the lower floors. Defeat 10.
Stone sentinels guard the lamp. Defeat 5 to light the beacon and open the vault.
Lighthouse of the Green Mists, near Nerys
The lighthouse beam has gone out and things that should not exist walk out of the mist. Climb to the top.
Inside: Citadel of the Shattered Stormgate
Step inside (Citadel of the Shattered Stormgate (depths)) and have a look around.
Gargoyles circle the citadel walls. Defeat 12.
The gate guard defends the generals' vault. Defeat 8.
Citadel of the Shattered Stormgate, near Selvaran
The Stormgate citadel fell in a single night. Its gate still cracks with lightning and the garrison never rests.
Step inside (Wyrmfen Hollow (depths)) and have a look around.
Nagas guard the passages to the nest. Defeat 10.
Crag dragons guard the treasure in the nest. Defeat 6.
A nest lies hidden in the fens that hunters will not speak of. Whoever returns earns a prize beyond dragon armour.
Inside: Vault of the Hollow Crown
Step inside (Vault of the Hollow Crown (depths)) and have a look around.
Wraith knights stand on every floor. Defeat 20.
Ash magi guard the crown. Defeat 10 and the kingdom's vault opens.
Vault of the Hollow Crown, near Valmir
The crown that has no head still calls for power. Its guards let no one leave empty-handed... or alive.
Oswin will lend his boat only to someone who knows the way: find the Magpie Burrow on the fields east of Varden and step inside. Bandits guard the door.
Bandits guard the burrow. Defeat 12 and the gate to the king's hall will give way.
The Magpie King keeps the brooch in a vault behind his hall. Defeat him and the vault key falls from his belt.
Open the chest in the vault and bring Oswin his family's silver brooch. In return he will take you to the Isle of Whispers.
Crabs cut the fishermen's nets. Defeat 10.
Pearls hide in the shells. Bring 3.
A pack howls outside the hermit's hut. Defeat 10 wolves.
Boars dig up the garden. Defeat 6.
Spiders have webbed the grottos. Defeat 10.
The hermit weaves robes. Bring 8 skeins of silk.
Shamans stir up the rest. Defeat 6.
The lightkeeper hears whispers at night from the grottos below. Go down and see.
Centipedes live in the ribs. Defeat 10.
Wights guard the way to the king's chamber. Defeat 12.
The Lord of the Cairn still rules the dead. Defeat him at the bottom of the mound.
Cartographer Halvar charts a frozen isle but needs steady hands. Stand at his map table on the quay.
Expedition guides need warm furs. Bring 8 yeti furs.
Ice golems block the northern trail. Defeat 10.
Halvar wants proof you can handle an island: the Lord of the Cairn on the Isle of Whispers must fall. Then you earn the sailing leave.
With the leave, sail to the Isle of the White Blizzard and set foot on its shore. Halvar will count out the rest of your reward.
Caravaneer Idris is gathering a crew for the Golden Dunes. Visit his tent in the harbour.
The caravan healer needs venom. Bring 12 scorpion tails.
Idris sells the way only to those who defeated the Jarl of the Rime on the Isle of the White Blizzard (the door needs a party).
Sail to the Isle of Golden Dunes and step onto its sand. Idris will pay the rest.
Botanist Ilvane studies flowers of the Emerald Mist. Visit her glasshouse by the dock.
The expedition needs sturdy boots. Bring 10 crocodile hides.
Serpents swarm the misty isthmus. Defeat 15.
Ilvane knows the route but wants a voucher: defeat the Regent of the Sandstorm on the Golden Dunes.
Step onto the Isle of Emerald Mist. Ilvane will pay the rest.
Warden Corwin keeps the guest list of the Ancient Oaks. Report to his post in the harbour.
The letter seal is cast from scales. Bring 6 wyvern scales.
Wraith knights block the road to the port. Defeat 12.
Corwin will add you to the list once you defeat the Empress of Vines in the Emerald Mist.
Walk beneath the Ancient Oaks. Corwin will pay the rest.
White lurkers hide in the drifts. Defeat 10.
Dragons nest in the spire. Defeat 8.
Skulkers ambush from the sand. Defeat 12.
Dragons nest in the crags. Defeat 8.
Lizards lurk in the fords. Defeat 12.
Cats drop from the trees. Defeat 10.
Gorgons turn men to stone. Defeat 8.
Quiet Landing on the east coast

We sail to the Isle of Whispers, but only with the ferryman Oswin's letter. Ask him about the brooch.
The ship is mine, but I lend the boat to the isle only to someone who gets my family brooch back from the Magpie King.
Wolves and spiders howl outside my hut. Will you help an old hermit?
The lighthouse shines, but whispers rise from the grottos beneath. Someone must look.
The mine and the cairn are my life, and now goblins and bones infest them.
My chart of the White Blizzard is unfinished. Help me and you will earn leave to sail.
The Golden Dunes are beautiful and deadly. My caravan will go with you if you earn consent.
The Emerald Mist hides flowers no one has seen. I will give you a pass once you prove yourself.
The Ancient Oaks admit only those I know. Earn my letter.
Furs, hooks and crampons for the trip. I also have jobs about yetis and ice beasts.
Pilgrims and golems walk the caves. Will you help?
The dunes shift and stings lurk beneath. I have jobs.
The obelisks are angry at men. Help me quiet them.
The jungle eats the careless. I know the trails and the jobs.
Orchids and hydras ruin my harvest. Will you help?
Boars and crones spoil the Oak woods. Help the rangers.
Orcs and ruin sentries trouble the realm. I have jobs for them.
I will not take you aboard without the brooch. Talk to Oswin at the quay and bring him what the Magpie King stole.
I sail to the mainland. Free, if you know why.
I sail to the White Blizzard only with Halvar of Frostholm's leave. Earn it first.
I sail to the mainland. Premium accounts only.
The Golden Dunes are closed. Caravaneer Idris in Qasirah knows how to earn leave.
I sail to the mainland. Premium accounts only.
The mist is thick and the reefs treacherous. Botanist Ilvane in Selvaran will give you a pass if you earn it.
I sail to the mainland. Premium accounts only.
The Ancient Oaks admit only guests known to Warden Corwin of Varden. Earn his letter.
